packMeta.name: StayReady (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey short-stay & Airbnb turnover manager: same-day checkout/check-in command board, bookings board, cleaner turnover pipeline, lockbox access directory, inspections & damage log, and per-property supply stock. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
